verdicts.reason: A keeps the original structure (logo, can, headline, CTA, legal) with clean centred alignment, the teal circle stays a corner accent, and spacing is reasonable. Flaws: the can is small, and the legal text is tiny and sits at the very bottom over the light-blue circle. B has the same tiny legal text, now sitting on the blue circle. B also puts the large teal circle behind the logo, sun and can, so the logo and can lose their clean background. The CTA is crammed right under the headline, and the layout is top-heavy with a dead gap above the legal line. B looks less intentional and less polished.
